v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of circuit-breaker-manager v1.0.0:

- Adds MCP dependency graph registration with DAG topology sort and cycle detection.
- Implements circuit breaker state machine with closed/open/half_open logic and automatic fail count, probe, and recovery.
- Introduces per-MCP Bulkhead isolation (asyncio.Semaphore), concurrent limit, and overloading/queue timeout detection.
- Supports persistent state, manual breaker reset, failure classification, and cascading fault analysis tools.
- Provides comprehensive input/output schemas, error codes, and usage workflow examples.
